question: Which icon should the Lower-third tag on the captions wear?
context: The captions mock puts a small violet Lower-third tag with the component icon on the top left of the lower third plate. The app already uses a violet chip with that icon on the canvas to mean this is a component. The tag is built and shows the label only until you choose.

options.label: Diamond icon, as the mock
options.summary: The tag reads Lower-third with the four-diamond icon in front, exactly as the captions mock draws it.
cons: That violet chip with four diamonds is the chip the canvas puts on every component, so it says your captions are a component, which they are not
options.mitigation: It only shows while the timeline is open and Lower third is picked, so it rarely sits next to a real component.

options.label: Label only, as built now
options.summary: The tag reads Lower-third on the violet chip with no icon. This is what the app shows today.
pros: Says what the style is and nothing more
Never mistaken for a component chip
cons: One step from the mock: no icon
options.mitigation: The tag keeps the mock spot, colour, size and words.

options.label: Captions icon instead
options.summary: The tag reads Lower-third with the small speech-bubble captions icon the Words track already wears.
pros: The icon says captions, which is true
options.mitigation: It is the icon the captions track already shows, so nothing new to learn.

options.label: Take the tag away
options.summary: No tag on the picture. The violet plate low on the left is the only sign of the style.
options.mitigation: The style stays named in the Caption style tiles in the panel.
